deadline.value: The department encourages Fall applicants to submit materials by January 15, with no priority deadline.
deadline.quote: we do encourage all applicants for Fall terms to submit their materials on or before January 15.

fee_waiver.value: The department gives application fee waivers only in very rare circumstances.
fee_waiver.quote: No, the department only offers fee waivers in very rare circumstances.

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE.
gre_general.quote: No. The GRE is not currently required.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require a Chemistry subject GRE.
gre_subject.quote: No. The GRE is not currently required.

supervisor.value: A faculty advisor is not needed before applying; research advisors are chosen by the end of the first long semester.
supervisor.quote: Is it necessary to secure a faculty advisor prior to submitting an application? No. | If admitted to the university, research advisors will be chosen by the end of the first long semester.

funding.value: Every student accepted into the PhD gets four years of TA or RA support if in good standing.
funding.quote: All students accepted in our program are guaranteed 4 years as an assistantship (either Teaching Assistant or Research Assistant), as long as they are in good standing.

entry_route.value: The FAQ does not state whether a master's is needed.
